scenarios.title: Search asset by partial asset name
preconditions: The user is on the Enterprise Data Catalog search page.
scenarios.expectedResult: The asset 'Customer Master' owned by 'Data Platform' of type 'Table' is displayed.

scenarios.title: Search asset by partial owner name
preconditions: The user is on the Enterprise Data Catalog search page.
The catalog contains assets owned by 'Finance Data'.
scenarios.expectedResult: The asset 'Sales Transactions' owned by 'Finance Data' is displayed.

scenarios.title: Case-insensitive asset search
preconditions: The user is on the Enterprise Data Catalog page.
scenarios.expectedResult: The asset 'Product Reference API' owned by 'Product Engineering' of type 'API' is displayed.

scenarios.title: Filter assets by Table asset type
preconditions: The user is viewing the asset catalog.
steps: Click on the Asset Type filter dropdown.
scenarios.expectedResult: Only assets of type 'Table' ('Customer Master' and 'Sales Transactions') are displayed.

scenarios.title: Clear active filters to display all assets
preconditions: An asset type filter such as 'File' is currently active in the catalog view.
steps: Verify only 'Supplier Data Feed' is shown.
scenarios.expectedResult: Active filters are cleared, type filter resets to 'All', and all four assets are listed.

scenarios.title: View asset details
preconditions: The user is on the asset catalog list page.
steps: Locate 'Product Reference API' in the asset list.
Click on 'Product Reference API' to open detail view.
scenarios.expectedResult: The detail view opens displaying owner 'Product Engineering' and type 'API'.

scenarios.title: Search with non-matching asset query
preconditions: The user is on the Enterprise Data Catalog search page.
scenarios.expectedResult: No assets match the search criteria, and an empty state message is shown.

scenarios.title: Search asset using single character boundary input
preconditions: The user is on the catalog search page.
scenarios.expectedResult: Exactly 3 assets containing 'S' in their name or owner are displayed: 'Customer Master', 'Sales Transactions', and 'Supplier Data Feed'.

scenarios.title: Search asset with leading and trailing whitespace
preconditions: The user is on the Enterprise Data Catalog search page.
steps: Enter '  Supplier Data Feed  ' with leading and trailing spaces.
scenarios.expectedResult: Search input is trimmed, and 'Supplier Data Feed' owned by 'Procurement Ops' is displayed.

scenarios.title: Filter by Table type with non-matching API search string
preconditions: The user is on the asset catalog page.
steps: Select 'Table' from the Asset Type filter.
Enter 'Product Reference API' in the search input.
scenarios.expectedResult: No search results are displayed because no Table asset matches the query 'Product Reference API'.
